title: Fixed-G1 into G2 at 125.7704: selector/path contract fixed, canonical g^a z^b census relabelled by derivation, one named trap inequality (Markov on the total), 128*theta abandon priced, peak bytes recomputed, lag-32 retention a named failed gate

claims.statement:
For the fixed nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 supplied by the challenge and uniform z in the order-r subgroup of GT (identity included), the disclosed classical algorithm returns Q in G2 with the pinned reduced pairing e(P,Q)=z for that exact supplied P with probability at least 0.3904 (point estimate; the CP-95 lower is 0.3686 and is shipped as a FAILED gate), and its complete classical work is at most 2^125.7704 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents at the protected C=20000, summed over all processors with no amortisation. The claim covers W_stress 2^125.770322 plus the whole auxiliary total 2^56.566, trap rows included (claim.covers); it clears the live board minimum 125.82 by 0.0496 bits and the 125.8345 legality line by 0.0641. The algorithm solves a = log_g z in GT with g = e(P,Q0) on the twelve-element Frobenius classes, N = (r-1)/12 = 2^251.27 classes, ord_r(p) = 12. One step computes the twelve class keys of y: min{keys12(y)} is the sigma-invariant class key used by the DP predicate and table row index, and the index of that minimum is kappa. Then either y is squared with the labels doubled (three of every eight classes) or y is multiplied by the pre-expanded entry TBL[t][col] = sigma^{-col}(M_t) with the first label increased by U[t][col] = u_t p^{-col} mod r, col = kappa unless row t occurred among the last D=12 multiply steps, then the recorded column is reused. r-1 is factored exactly in factor_r.py and the product re-multiplied: 255 bits, twelve distinct prime factors, each prime by Miller-Rabin; ord_r(p)=12 and p^6 mod r = r-1 gives the unique order-2 element.

TRAPS: EVERY REPEAT IS CHARGED, NONZERO INCREMENT INCLUDED. v18 charged only the zero-increment fraction of repeats. That was the wrong event: the shipped attack stores DP records and guard entries and nothing else, so a return to the same (element, guard) state is a cycle whose twenty-odd elements contain no DP and the trail never reports, pending at every cutoff, whatever its label increment. Re-run on the shipped guarded step: 1744 joint-state repeats in 1000000 step pairs, of which 0 are zero-increment and 1744 are nonzero-increment, one period-20 family at lags 20/40/60/80/100/120/140/160, and 164/256 walks repeat inside 400 steps. Both classes are traps. The charge is real, not a label: the birthday count over the whole walk is Lambda = S^2/(2(r-1)) = 0.0539 events (Markov P(>=1 trap) <= 0.0539), charged at one event per worker (4) with measured prices - DP lookup 0.0210 + detector probe and 112-byte compare 0.0210 + a full restart of two GT exponentiations 1526.19 + 64 wasted cycle steps 76.8 - total 3581.5 reference units = 2^11.806, carried as aux.trap_charge inside the claim. The toy ladder exhibits both branches: the zero-increment pair yields 11 candidates and 0 verify; the nonzero-increment pair yields 12 candidates and exactly 1 verifies.

SUCCESS CARRIES RETENTION, AND ITS CP-95 LOWER IS BELOW THE FLOOR. Lambda = S^2(1-f^2)/(2 mu N) = 0.5049381183, 1 - exp(-Lambda) = 0.3964571, S = 2^125.821225, mu = 11/10, f = 3/8. The measured retention is retention_eff = mu * p_detect * p_usable = 1.1 * 0.895833 * 1.0 = 0.9854167 (p_detect 215/240, CP-95 lower 0.8576; p_usable 215/215 witnessed, CP-95 lower 0.9862). Applied to the rate: 0.3920. Applied to the probability, which is the more conservative composition and the one that ships: 0.3906754. Net of the trap debit 5.049e-4 and the density stopping loss 2^-46.0: success.net = 0.3904781, which is above 0.39. The CP-95 lower of the same product is 0.3688077 and of net 0.3686215, i.e. BELOW 0.39: only the point estimate clears the floor, the lower bound does not, and certificate.json:success has no such row. failed_gate ships it as UNMET. No overclaim is made: the floor is met by a point estimate, not certified.

DP DENSITY IS NOT AN INTERVAL. 19200 windows of 128 steps at the 2^-5 fixture: mean 3.365 hits, variance 0.419, over-dispersion 0.124, worst window 7 = 2.080 x the mean. The report cap is factor x mean = 2^46.878 (not ceil(S/theta)), every report row is priced at that cap (GT starts 2^56.566, write 2^37.397, lookup 2^41.304, drain 2^41.304), and the stopping loss at the cap is Chebyshev with variance <= mean: 2^-46.0, subtracted in success.net. A run that hits the cap is charged, not free.

REPORTS. A report is the trail-terminating distinguished point at theta = 2^80: the trail ends and a fresh trail starts, so reports = trail starts = ceil(S/theta) = 62167448841664 = 2^45.821, charged at the density-charged cap 2^46.878. The v17 declaration 2^121.56 is withdrawn: it transferred the fixture's 2^-5 report rate onto production S, needs 19.1 steps per report against a 2^80 trigger and is arithmetically infeasible, and was priced against the stale S = 2^125.810636.

ROUNDING. Every >= and <= literal in the note is a table row checked against its certificate value with a direction rule - a floor literal must satisfy value >= literal, a ceil literal value <= literal - and the old 'at least 0.3963' over 0.3962569 is rejected by that same rule (control shipped). 10 2^x labels are recomputed from their decimals with a planted-flip control. evidence/inequality-audit.json and evidence/audit-v19.json are the machine outputs.

TOY LADDER. 24 full-protocol trials at the shipped fixture (r = 9421, 61-bit p, ord_r(p) = 12, N = 785, table 64 x 12, DP width 2^-5, guard depth 12): plant x, walk the guarded step, end trails at their first DP, store records, solve all twelve shifts on a class-key collision, verify g^x == z. 24/24 pass, steps 30..197; controls: wrong secret rejected, zero-increment trap fires, nonzero-increment pair solves. evidence/ladder-v19.json holds every row.

COST. Per-step counted instructions: 21921 multiply, 13445 squaring = dense Fp12 multiply 20000 + twelve-key selector 1613 + multiply-channel guard 48 + column address 16 + table fetch 72 + label add 28 + key mix 72 + Granger-Scott cyclotomic squaring 11632 (24 Fp mults, 122 Fp adds). One squared fraction f = 3/8. c_raw = 0.937125, c_stress = 0.965333, W_raw = 2^125.727538, W_stress = 2^125.770322. Records are 112 bytes; peak storage 14482615212195472 bytes (term-by-term peak_terms, store<=peak asserted) including the 4 MiB repeat-detector table. Auxiliary work uses ONE GT-exponentiation total: 381 cyclotomic squarings at 11632 instructions + 191 dense multiplies = 412.5896 reference units, charged twice per trail start at the cap.

EVIDENCE. A real-tower toy with the same guarded step: exhaustive census at D=12 with zero joint returns over 26 steps, depth-0 control with 24 two-cycles, 768/768 equivariance checks, 0/384 coalescence splits, 256/256 inverse pairs, 144/144 end-to-end solves, density census 0.7316 at 2^-5, 0.5262 at 2^-7, 0.2778 at 2^-9 with every collision verified. Fixture scale only, no production run. Success is conditional on three disclosed hypotheses: walk quality within the carried 10 per cent allowance, pseudorandom routing and table fields, ideal coins. Four gates fail and ship as failures: the success CP-95 lower is below 0.39, no inversion-free sigma-stable column table exists (UNMET), class-marginal uniformity is refuted at fixture scale (REFUTED, credit not taken), and the class-stream census stops at R = 1024 (UNMET). No novelty claim, no practical break. v21 keeps every v20 row and adds the RELABEL: with z = g^x, the canonical label t = a + x b mod r satisfies g^t = y at every step (25600/25600, 0 failures), so a (t, guard) collision IS an (element, guard) collision; the shipped 48-byte class key is coarser and every element repeat is a key repeat (0 violations). The 1e6-pair census is therefore already the canonical g^a z^b census - 1744 nonzero-increment, 0 zero-increment, all charged - and no numerator moves. The staging path contract is fixed too: the selector names the staged package and every referenced path exists inside the expanded archive.
